declaration.declared_before: any return, lift, matched estimate, cost stress or bootstrap was computed on the confirmation block
declaration.declared_after: a read-only coverage audit of the minute store that compared the current symbol list against the E1 tape binding and counted rows per symbol; no return was read
declaration.purpose: confirmation, not discovery. H5 is reproduced verbatim from the E1 declaration and is not modified, relaxed, tightened, extended or re-thresholded for any reason, including a disappointing result.
declaration.question: With H5 unchanged, does the Open->5m excess survive a new out-of-sample block, price and liquidity matched controls, and a realistic round-trip cost?

frozen_inputs.code_reuse: app.backtest.strategy_e1_premarket premarket/cohort/dataset modules are imported unmodified so that the confirmation block is processed by exactly the code that produced the development result
frozen_inputs.no_new_collection: this study issues no provider API call and does not interfere with the running B-minute collector; it takes no writer lock and writes nothing under the minute store

hypothesis.statement: premarket_gap > 0 and premarket_rvol >= 3.0 and position_in_premarket_range >= 0.8 and return_0900_0925 > 0
hypothesis.feature_definitions: e1_premarket_rules_v1.json section 'features', reproduced by importing the E1 code unchanged
hypothesis.modification_forbidden: no threshold, no feature, no additional condition, no H6 or H7. A different rule is a different study and needs its own declaration.

horizons.primary_definition: close of the last bar starting at or before 09:34 ET divided by the open of the 09:30 bar, minus 1; identical to the E1 primary reading
horizons.strict_variant_reported: R_5M_strict, the exact 09:34 bar, reported as a sensitivity
horizons.no_primary_switch: if R_1M or R_15M looks better in this study the primary is NOT changed. The primary was fixed by the E1 result before this study began.

DEVELOPMENT.definition: the 1,902 symbols bound by the E1 run (tape digest d12ff28a...)
DEVELOPMENT.use: reference and neutralization diagnostics only. No DEVELOPMENT number can produce a PASS.
DEVELOPMENT.rationale: every one of these rows was observed while the E1 result was written

CONFIRMATION.definition: symbols present in the minute store that were absent from the E1 tape binding, frozen at confirmation_tape_digest before any return was computed
CONFIRMATION.use: the only block that can produce a PASS

FINAL_HOLDOUT.definition: the last chronological block of genuinely new data
FINAL_HOLDOUT.expected_status: NOT CONSTRUCTIBLE and declared so in advance
FINAL_HOLDOUT.reason: the B collector advances alphabetically over a fixed scope window (2026-04-20..2026-09-16), so newly arrived data is new SYMBOLS over the SAME sessions, not new sessions. The daily snapshot USB-HIST-V1 is frozen at 2026-09-16, so no later session could enter the universe even if its minutes existed. A chronological holdout therefore cannot be cut from what exists.
FINAL_HOLDOUT.forbidden_substitute: a random or symbol-wise split of the confirmation block is NOT a chronological holdout and must not be reported as one

matched_control.purpose: separate the H5 effect from a price, liquidity or gap-size premium
matched_control.method: coarsened exact matching, deterministic. No propensity model, no ML, no fitted weights.
matched_control.control_pool: universe observations in the same block that do NOT satisfy H5

primary_estimator.name: session_demeaned_cell_matching
primary_estimator.step_1: adj(i) = R_5M(i) - mean R_5M over all universe rows of the same session, which removes the market-wide move of that morning
primary_estimator.step_2: matched_lift = mean over H5 rows of [adj(i) - mean adj over non-H5 control rows in the same match cell]
primary_estimator.unmatched: an H5 row whose cell holds no control is dropped and counted; the match rate is reported

secondary_estimator.name: same_session_cell_matching
secondary_estimator.definition: the same cell matching but the control pool is restricted to the same session, with no demeaning
secondary_estimator.use: stricter sensitivity; reported with its own match rate, never used to overturn the primary

matched_control.median_and_win_rate: computed on the same matched differences as the mean

robustness.price_bucket_merge_rule: a reported price bucket with fewer than 30 H5 rows is merged into the adjacent higher bucket before reporting; the merge is mechanical and declared here, not chosen after seeing results
extreme_removal: top 1 row by the matched difference
concentration: top 1 symbol share of total matched excess
Herfindahl index over per-symbol shares of matched excess

time_consistency.granularity: month, and quarter where a quarter holds enough rows
time_consistency.broad_universe_only: periods in which the broad minute universe does not exist (before 2026-04-20) are reported separately and are NOT summed into broad-market evidence

regime.allowed_inputs: SPY information known at or before the decision time only
labels: trailing 20-session universe volatility through D-1, split at its own median
regime.forbidden: any regime label built from the same-day regular-session outcome

bootstrap.primary_unit: session cluster (all rows of one session resample together)
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 / 97.5 of the matched mean lift
bootstrap.primary_is_conservative: the session cluster interval is the one the gate reads

cost_stress.break_even_cost_bp: the assumed round-trip cost at which net_matched_lift reaches zero, i.e. the gross matched lift expressed in basis points
cost_stress.basis: Stocks Basic carries no quote, so no spread is measured anywhere in this study. 10 bp round trip is declared as a deliberately modest floor for the sub-$20, low-premarket-volume names that dominate H5; it is a declared assumption, not an estimate from data.

execution_reality.not_claimed: the 09:30 open is not treated as an executable fill, and no number in this study is net of spread, impact, imbalance or auction effects
execution_reality.required_before_promotion: a separate Execution Model is required after promotion and is out of scope here

sample_gate.no_lowering: if the confirmation block does not reach the minimum, the threshold is NOT lowered. The verdict becomes INCONCLUSIVE and the required additional coverage is computed and reported.
sample_gate.yield_basis: the development block produced 1,729 H5 rows from 1,902 symbols, i.e. 0.909 rows per symbol; this is used only to size the shortfall, never to impute results

gate.evaluated_on: the CONFIRMATION block, primary horizon R_5M, matched-control primary estimator

pass_requires_all.downside_metric: P(R_5M <= -0.01) of H5 divided by the same probability of its matched controls
pass_requires_all.price_neutralized_positive: the matched mean lift is positive in the majority of reported price buckets that clear the 30-row minimum
pass_requires_all.liquidity_neutralized_positive: the same in the reported liquidity buckets
pass_requires_all.time_direction_consistent: the matched mean lift has the same sign in the majority of months of the broad-universe period
pass_requires_all.net_positive_at_declared_cost: net_matched_lift > 0 at an assumed round-trip cost of 10 bp

gate.inconclusive_requires: the signal survives in direction but the confirmation sample, the holdout or the cost test is insufficient to decide
gate.fail_requires: the matched mean lift is non-positive on the confirmation block, or the edge disappears under price and liquidity neutralization, or it is negative net of the declared cost while also failing the bootstrap
gate.holdout_rule: if a final holdout cannot be constructed, the verdict may not be PASS. The best available outcome is CONFIRMATION_PASS_BUT_HOLDOUT_INSUFFICIENT, which does not promote H5 to Strategy E.
gate.no_post_hoc_edit: no threshold in this file is edited after a result is seen.

artifacts.run_id: e1h5-<12 hex of the run identity digest>
